big: Take the 100 largest companies. Remove the top 50. What is left is the Nifty Next 50: the next rung of large companies, many of which may one day join the Nifty 50.

lines: What does the Nifty Next 50 actually track?
It represents 50 companies from the Nifty 100 after excluding the Nifty 50 companies. Weights follow periodic capped free float. It is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
